info.name: Playlist Gobbler
info.summary: Central playlist repository for AIMP and Jellyfin
info.description: Keeps playlists (AIMP .aimppl4, .m3u8, ...) in one Nextcloud folder per user, so desktop and Android players and the Jellyfin plugin all sync from the same source. Part of the gobbler project. Scaffold: no features yet.
info.author: Shawn Tolley
